services.name: Exhibit Your Art
services.desc: Our community art shows take place about four times a year, with the call for art going out about one month prior. To stay up to date, we recommend that you keep an eye on our exhibit calendar and sign up for our email list. To submit your work to a community exhibit, download the related documents found in the “Call for Artists,” and bring your completed forms along with your artwork to the gallery at the time and date specified. The Signature Gallery at the Frank Bette Center for the Arts (FBCA) is a dedicated exhibition space separate from the Main Gallery, featuring independently curated shows.
